text: Integrated the drafted checkpoint observer into the acquired-image runner through explicit --checkpoint-accepted, --checkpoint-rejected, --checkpoint-max-states and --checkpoint-manifest flags. With no flags, the ordinary optimize path remains selected. A frozen manifest hash accompanies every event. RealImageCheckpoints.scala saves raw midpoint fields on their original pyramid grids, then separately regrids copied states to native prepared-image grids for diagnostic export; native export rejection/construction failures remain recorded. Every event has structured JSON with trial and rebuilt objective/weight data, controller state, capture status and optional artifact directory. Nonfinite trial values serialize as null; labels are absent from the interface. Added two runner checks for bounded/complete flags and JSON encoding, plus the six observer checks already drafted. All Scala compilation/testing and real-image replays remain deferred until reference timing completes; no test-pass or scientific improvement claim is made for this uncompiled work. Existing pre-instrumentation engine, runner and runner-suite source bytes have separate preserved copies. Common fixed-region intensity scoring, the five-case diagnostic manifest, per-structure trajectories and reproduction receipts remain outstanding.
